plugins.name: build-loop
plugins.description: Multi-phase build orchestration with native architecture awareness, integrated debugging, and repo-episodic-memory: assess, plan, execute, review, iterate. Owns a Python-native architecture engine (scan/impact/trace/rules/dead/lessons) with NavGator demoted to optional escalation adapter; aggressive freshness via SessionStart + PreToolUse Edit/Write hooks (extension-allowlisted, single-flight, doc-edits never fire scans); Architecture Context Pack injected into subagent briefs at Phase 2/3/4/5; architecture-scout read-only Sonnet subagent dispatched at Phase 1 baseline / 2 chunk-impact fan-out / 4D rules / 5 iterate-subgraph / 6 learn-sync. Capability registry (116 entries × 6 kinds × 10 categories) + ≤8 shortlist with plugin-surface collapse + trigger-aware demotion keeps the orchestrator below the empirical tool-selection ceiling; Phase 1 invocation is mandatory and caches into state.json so Phase 2/3 dispatchers inherit instead of re-scoring. Unified recall() facade fans across runs / decisions (legacy + canonical build-loop-memory store) / Postgres semantic_facts / debugger MCP backends with graceful degradation; backend_health probe surfaces store status visibly each Phase 1 and is consumed by Phase 5 Iterate to short-circuit unavailable backends. Plan-verify gate on Phase 2 covers security rules + schema-migration-full-chain (catches recurring writer/reader drift). Phase 4-A build-time security review (OWASP LLM/Agentic Top 10 + MITRE ATLAS) when riskSurfaceChange triggers. DOE-first multi-factor optimization with autoresearch baseline handoff. Optional UI design gates. Bundled debug-loop, debugging-memory, logging-tracer, security-methodology, defenseclaw-bridge skills + MCP incident-memory server. v0.10 introduces global path/schema resolver and project-tagged decision capture in a private build-loop-memory store with personal_memory Postgres schema; lessons survive project deletion and are scoped via project tags.
